changeSet.author: codex

preConditions.onFailMessage: Release candidate active-plan index must exist and non-published active candidates must be unique
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM ( SELECT tenant_id, plan_id FROM modeling_model_release_candidate WHERE status NOT IN ('REJECTED', 'ROLLED_BACK', 'STALE', 'CANCELLED', 'PUBLISHED') GROUP BY tenant_id, plan_id HAVING count(*) > 1 ) duplicate_active_plan

changeSet.comment: Treat PUBLISHED release candidates as immutable delivery history rather than the active plan slot. This lets the same warehouse plan deliver its next dependency-bounded scope while retaining publication, rollback and operational-run evidence for earlier scopes.
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX CONCURRENTLY uk_model_release_candidate_active_plan_published_history ON modeling_model_release_candidate (tenant_id, plan_id) WHERE status NOT IN ('REJECTED', 'ROLLED_BACK', 'STALE', 'CANCELLED', 'PUBLISHED')

rollback.sql: DO $$ BEGIN IF EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM modeling_model_release_candidate WHERE status NOT IN ('REJECTED', 'ROLLED_BACK', 'STALE', 'CANCELLED') GROUP BY tenant_id, plan_id HAVING count(*) > 1 ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'ROLLBACK_BLOCKED_PUBLISHED_CANDIDATE_HISTORY_HAS_NEXT_DELIVERY'; END IF; END $$

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX CONCURRENTLY uk_model_release_candidate_active_plan_published_active ON modeling_model_release_candidate (tenant_id, plan_id) WHERE status NOT IN ('REJECTED', 'ROLLED_BACK', 'STALE', 'CANCELLED')
